title: Build deterministic brewing simulation and shared contracts

brief.goal: Create the game foundation and complete testable brewing state transitions independent of graphics.
brief.context: The repository contains only docs/prompts/mash_burn_prd.md. Create project.godot and a built-in headless SceneTree test harness rather than depending on an unspecified test addon. Define protocol v1 BatchState, PlayerCommand, HazardEvent, JudgeResult and HardwareFrame schemas in src/contracts/, reserving hazard/fire/disconnect events now. BrewingSimulation.advance(state, command, dt_seconds) returns a new state plus events; all random choices take an explicit seed. Include water ion balance and approximate pH, alpha/beta enzyme temperature curves, conversion/scorching, Tinseth IBU/gravity/vigor and hop oils, cooling/infection probability, yeast attenuation/flocculation/temperature-driven esters and fusels, CO2 pressure-temperature and priming/overpressure. Parameters and approximations must be visible; no claim of laboratory-grade accuracy. Commit a short architecture/design note with the implementation, not by changing this PRD.
brief.acceptance:
- [x] Began with failing deterministic/formula tests; chemistry 42 checks and contracts 24 checks exit 0 on Godot 4.4.1.
- [x] Protocol v1 executable validator, JSON Schema and five round-trip examples define units, bounds, ordering, clocks, malformed rejection and hazard safe-state.
- [x] Tests cover fixed tick hashes, invalid amounts/dt, near-zero volume, mash range/pH, IBU, heat/mass bounds, cooling exposure, fermentation and overpriming.
- [x] Located Godot 4.4.1 and Python 3.11.9; documented approximations and formula-derived fixture provenance.
brief.handoff: Pure simulation and protocol v1 ready. Presentation should use fixed 60 s advances, can_next(), full-state saves, and explicit seq/tick commands. Pressure hazards apply only to sealed packaging/judging.

title: Build mock hardware HAL and private notification service

brief.goal: Create a decoupled FastAPI daemon, transport adapters and fail-safe authorization boundary.
brief.context: Consume protocol v1 frames with step, target_temp_c, pump_duty, valve_states and hop_drop_hopper; transmit at 10 Hz with monotonic sequence, timestamp and hazard status. Implement mocked Serial/MQTT/WebSocket adapters and configurable real transport backends behind explicit arming. Tier 1 covers probes/PID relays/dosing/hop servos. Tier 2 exposes bounded waypoint planning and a simulated arm only until calibrated collision/workspace limits exist. The bridge must stop on lost heartbeat, malformed/stale frames, missing sensor data, E-stop, fire/staging, disconnection and temperature >=102 C; independently implemented firmware cutoff is mandatory before real actuation. No automatic rearm. FastAPI POST /api/v1/psyops/roast accepts authenticated local requests and forwards only to explicitly configured consenting private channels. Document configuration names without reading .env files.

- [ ] Safety tests prove disarm is latched, outputs go safe and queued commands are discarded for every fault, temperature >=102 C and fire/staging; rearm requires a fresh explicit local action and healthy interlocks.
- [ ] Hardware-free operation and all transport mock round-trips pass; real transport adapters cannot arm with unverified firmware safeguards.
